field_replacements.expected_old_field: Native launch_external_editor uses a worker thread, a NamedTempFile with ice-draft- prefix/.md suffix, writes the expanded draft and chooses ICE_EXTERNAL_EDITOR (nonblank), then VISUAL, EDITOR, or notepad/nano. Command::new receives the whole environment string as one executable with no argument parsing. Successful exit reads the file without stripping a trailing newline; errors are returned through TuiMessage (`rust:crates/ice-cli/src/interactive_tui/run.rs:72-118`). The key caller launches and immediately continues with no terminal stop/start or exclusive editor-operation state in this path; result handling unconditionally replaces the current draft. A late result can therefore overwrite edits made while the child was open. 2521 | /// Publish the active session's id to plugins, on both channels that carry it.
2522 | ///
2523 | /// Called on **every** activation of a session — the startup build AND every
2524 | /// in-process swap (`switch_to_session`, `fork_session`, and the plugin
2525 | /// `NewSession`/`Fork`/`SwitchSession` runtime actions all route through
2526 | /// [`set_active_session`]). Two things must stay in step:
2527 | ///
2528 | /// - `ToolCallContext` — read per plugin **tool** call, which is why a stale
2529 | ///   value there made a plugin's `todo`-style state follow the wrong session.
2530 | /// - `ICERS_SESSION_ID` — read per **turn** by the provider hooks, which is the
2531 | ///   only channel an observer gets for a pure-chat run. Process-global, which is
2532 | ///   exactly the scope of "the session this process is serving".
2533 | ///
2534 | /// The write overwrites unconditionally, deliberately. An inherited value is not
2535 | /// an override: `icers` spawning `icers` would otherwise hand the child the parent's
2536 | /// session id, and the child — which is *serving its own* session — would report
2537 | /// it forever. (Children no longer inherit the variable at all; see
2538 | /// `ice_tools::HOST_PRIVATE_ENV`. This overwrite is the second line of defence,
2539 | /// for any other way a value can arrive pre-set.)
2540 | ///
2541 | /// An embedder that genuinely wants to pin the id can revert to the old
2542 | /// behaviour by setting the variable *after* this runs; there is no supported
2543 | /// way to pin it before, because a session that does not match its own id is
2544 | /// never what the caller wants.
2545 | fn publish_session_identity(tool_context: &ice_extensions::ToolCallContext, id: &str) {
2546 |     std::env::set_var(ice_plugin_sdk::SESSION_ID_ENV, id);
2547 |     tool_context.set_session_id(id);
2548 | }
2549 | 
2550 | /// Swap the session the harness serves, republishing the identity to plugins.
2551 | ///
2552 | /// The single funnel for an in-process session change. Prefer this over calling
2553 | /// `AgentHarness::set_session` directly: the harness holds no reference to the
2554 | /// plugin channels, so a bare `set_session` would leave every plugin reporting
2555 | /// the session it had before the swap.
2556 | ///
2557 | /// `tool_context` is optional because not every caller has one (the harness's own
2558 | /// tests, a headless embedder); the env channel is always published, since the
2559 | /// provider hooks depend on it.
2560 | pub(crate) async fn set_active_session(
2561 |     harness: &AgentHarness,
2562 |     session: Session,
2563 |     tool_context: Option<&ice_extensions::ToolCallContext>,
2564 | ) -> Result<(), String> {
2565 |     let metadata = session.get_metadata().await.ok();
2566 |     harness
2567 |         .set_session(session)
2568 |         .await
2569 |         .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
2570 |     if let Some(metadata) = metadata {
2571 |         std::env::set_var(ice_plugin_sdk::SESSION_ID_ENV, &metadata.id);
2572 |         if let Some(context) = tool_context {
2573 |             context.set_session_id(metadata.id);
2574 |         }
2575 |     }
2576 |     Ok(())
2577 | }

 57 | /// A config-layer error (path resolution, IO, JSON). Surfaced to the user by

 89 | /// The icers config directory (`~/.icers/agent` by default, `ICERS_CODING_AGENT_DIR`
 90 | /// override). Creates nothing — purely a path computation. The `agent/` layer
 91 | /// is `join(homedir(), CONFIG_DIR_NAME, "agent")`. The env override points at
 92 | /// the agent dir itself.
 93 | pub fn agent_dir() -> Result<PathBuf, ConfigError> {
 94 |     if let Some(val) = std::env::var_os(CONFIG_DIR_ENV) {
 95 |         let p = PathBuf::from(&val);

 97 |             return Err(ConfigError::RelativeOverride {
 98 |                 env: CONFIG_DIR_ENV,
 99 |                 val: val.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
100 |             });
101 |         }
102 |         return Ok(p);
103 |     }
104 |     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or(ConfigError::NoHomeDir {
105 |         env: CONFIG_DIR_ENV,
106 |     })?;
107 |     Ok(home.join(CONFIG_DIR_NAME).join("agent"))
108 | }

proposed_catalog_object.title: Renamed session-value discriminator omits historical native values during restoration
proposed_catalog_object.behavior: When a historical native session still contains customType='ice.value' records and no external migration has rewritten them before loading, active SessionValues omits those records from its latest-wins value view. The underlying generic custom entries can remain in the session log. A concrete native caller loads display.hide_thinking through this API; under that condition, an older saved session preference is not restored and the existing settings default remains.
proposed_catalog_object.technical_explanation: The local identity change replaces VALUE_CUSTOM_TYPE='ice.value' with 'icers.value' at values.rs:32. SessionValues::load passes the new discriminator into an exact custom_type storage query at lines 43-53; from_entries also skips every entry whose custom_type differs from that constant at lines 57-82. SessionValueWriter appends only the new discriminator at lines 119-147. A complete active crates search for ice.value, icers.value and VALUE_CUSTOM_TYPE found only the new constant/example, its two read filters, its writer and the module re-export. Both production direct callers found by the scoped caller search pass harness.session() directly to load. In the bounded native JSONL path, the custom-entry decoder copies the raw customType string, replay changes parent_id rather than the discriminator, and common query matching compares custom_type exactly. No historical alias or rewrite appears in that inspected path.
proposed_catalog_object.assumptions: Requires historical raw native ice.value records to reach the active API without an external migration. This is source-level reasoning, not a reproduced runtime result. No real sessions or user configuration directories were inspected; no application, test, terminal or migration was executed. External import/migration utilities and arbitrary third-party SessionStorage implementations were not exhaustively inspected. This finding concerns values omitted from the projected view, not deletion of the generic log records.
proposed_catalog_object.parity_relation: Active native compatibility regression introduced by identity rebranding; not a new missing TypeScript-parity requirement. The inspected TypeScript gap entries do not establish a precise existing SESSION owner for the generic native SessionValues API, so entry_ids is intentionally empty. The existing native read/write API and the remaining v4 durability behavior stay credited.
proposed_catalog_object.provenance: Active line-32 blame identifies cae01ac2ff307987a46cde130ef9c0d3c59c4381 (chore(ice): give the Rust build its own icers identity). A bounded git show for values.rs confirms the executable ice.value→icers.value replacement and its example update. The frozen old file has the historical discriminator and the active file has the new one. Local git merge-base --is-ancestor returns exit 1 for this introducing commit against the recorded upstream commit; this establishes that this commit is not an ancestor of that upstream reference, not a complete independent upstream behavior comparison.
